title: Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program Refill Cycle Table
content:
Supply days per refill shipment on the Insulin and Injection Supply Pharmacy Program are a multiple of 30 calendar days, and each tier fixes them together with four other refill-cycle figures.

| Figure | Definition |
|---|---|
| Supply days per shipment | Standard days of supply in one refill shipment, in calendar days (a multiple of 30) |
| Refill contact lead | Earliest point for Larkfield's refill-reminder contact, in calendar days before the planned ship date |
| Refill ship lead | Earliest point a refill may ship, in calendar days before the end of the supply of the previous refill of the same item (the plan's refill-too-soon limit) |
| Refill confirmation required | Whether each refill requires the customer's own confirmation of continued use and quantity on hand before it ships; "No" means subscription shipping on schedule |
| Maximum days' supply | Longest days' supply the plan pays in one fill |

| Tier | Supply days per shipment | Refill contact lead (days) | Refill ship lead (days) | Refill confirmation required | Maximum days' supply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program | 30 | 7 | 7 | No | 90 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial HMO Program | 90 | 14 | 18 | Yes | 90 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Commercial PPO Program | 90 | 14 | 18 | Yes | 90 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Advantage Prescription Drug Program | 90 | 14 | 22 | Yes | 90 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part D Program | 90 | 14 | 22 | Yes | 90 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicare Part B Pump Insulin Program | 90 | 14 | 10 | Yes | 90 |
| Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program | 30 | 10 | 6 | Yes | 34 |

## Comparisons across tiers

- Two tiers ship 30-day refills — the Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program and the Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program; the other five ship 90-day refills.
- The Insulin Pharmacy Self-Pay Program is the only tier marked "No" for refill confirmation, meaning its refills ship on the subscription schedule.
- The Insulin Pharmacy Medicaid Program pays at most 34 days' supply in one fill; every other tier pays up to 90.
- Hypothetical comparison of the refill ship lead: for a previous 90-day refill whose supply ends on a given day, a tier with an 18-day lead lets the next refill of the same item ship from the 18th calendar day before that end date, and a tier with a 22-day lead from the 22nd calendar day before it.
